content:
jas (AE): Heads-up: CloudNova wants SOC2 attestation, ISO27001 cert copy, a signed pen-test attestation letter (scope + signer), a sanitized network diagram, and staging IPs before the POC start. They also asked whether Dedicated is required to guarantee EU-only data residency and what the incremental cost is for a 30-day POC. Can someone assemble the bundle and provide a presigned upload for them to drop docs?

rachel (SE): I can own the bundle + cost delta. Quick clarifications: we require NDA before sharing full SOC2 PDF; can give attestation summary immediately. For presigned uploads we typically create a single-object PUT with 72h expiry, SSE, and no public ACL. Example curl: curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/pdf" --data-binary @file.pdf

harry (Security): Pen-test policy: we provide a signed attestation letter that lists scope, testing date, and 3rd-party tester. Full vuln findings are not released without redaction and legal approval. If customer insists Dedicated be included in-scope for the pen-test, that triggers an infra addendum and ~2-3 week lead time. Attestation must name an authorized security signer.

legal-bot: NDA template and pen-test attestation template available at /legal/templates. Pen-test attestation requires named security lead and company stamp; we cannot auto-sign.

room-bot: Secure dataroom created: DR-6001. Presigned uploads enabled. Access: jas, rachel, harry.

rachel (SE): I'll provision DR-6001 artifacts: SOC2 attestation summary (pdf), ISO cert (pdf), draft pen-test attestation (unsigned), sanitized network diagram template, ingress CIDR placeholders (txt), and a short upload HOWTO. ETA: 6 hours.

jas (AE): I'll ask CloudNova for the CISO name/title and request execution of NDA. Also confirming whether they want Dedicated in the POC scope or only Hosted with EU residency via region placement.

harry (Security): One more note: if they request CVE-level details we need to run the redaction checklist and loop legal early. Share signatory info asap.

jas (AE): Got it. Will update when NDA signed or when they confirm signer. Thanks team. :pray:
